concepts.title: Midnight Atelier
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high-fidelity Windows desktop application concept, a flat straight-on screenshot without device framing, wide 16:10 layout.
Primary request: Design "Image Wizard", a beautiful, production-plausible local AI image studio powered by Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo. This is a creative workspace, not a marketing website. It needs text-to-image, image-to-image, natural-language image editing, a local model installer, and an image library.
Content: Same main studio screen for all concepts. App name "Image Wizard". Navigation "Create", "Transform", "Edit", "Library", "Models". Selected "Create". Prompt text "A sculptural glass orchid, soft morning light, editorial still life". A gorgeous central preview of a translucent sculptural glass orchid with pale blush petals on dark burgundy silk, detailed natural refractions, beautifully lit. Four small related result thumbnails with clearly visible image details. Show an intentional generation status "Generating · Step 5 of 8" with a subtle progress indication. Visible settings: model "Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo", ratio "1:1", size "2048 × 2048", seed "Random", "Transparent background". A modest local setup affordance reading "Local engine" and "Manage". Primary button "Generate". Secondary action "Export PNG". A reference upload area "Add reference images". Do not invent numeric timing estimates, enormous titles, noisy charts, or dozens of cards.
Constraints: legible typography, coherent spacing, actual application controls, beautiful central artwork, realistic density, no device mockup, no watermark, no glassmorphism. Every component has a role. Render precisely one complete concept per image.
Design thesis A, "Midnight Atelier": A rich charcoal-black professional creative tool with restrained copper-orange accents, elegant small typographic hierarchy, substantial art canvas and crisp thin divisions. Three-column architecture: left 270px composition panel with compact mode tabs, prompt and references; center large artwork and a shallow filmstrip below; right 210px slim parameter inspector. Top slim native-style titlebar and understated icon navigation. Off-black subtly warm backgrounds, amber single primary action, off-white text, delicate warm gray rule lines. Feels like refined photography software rather than a generic dashboard. Keep the artwork immersive and controls compact, craftsmanship and quiet confidence.

Compact breadcrumb titlebar with Image Wizard name and local engine management. A thin recent-images rail above the bottom composer. Flat matte surfaces, exceptionally clear hierarchy, purposeful asymmetry, sophisticated creative workspace with room for future editing tools. Avoid complex node graphs, purple glow, excessive shadows or glass.
